title: <<the lesson title, 8 words or fewer>>
subtitle: <<one short line under the title>>
lessonType: <<problem if the learner must solve problems step by step, otherwise concept>>

learner.course: <<course name and instructor; for self-study write nothing between the quotes>>
learner.purpose: <<self-study: why they want to learn it; for a course write nothing>>
materials: <<each thing they gave you: notes, slides, study guide, textbook with edition; use [] if nothing>>
learner.checked: <<course: not-yet until every course claim is matched to their materials; self-study: not-a-course>>
learner.target: <<a question they missed before, if you know one; otherwise nothing>>
learner.notation: <<symbols or words their course uses, if you know them; otherwise nothing>>

objectives: <<goal 1, starting with a verb such as Explain or Solve>>
question: <<the one question the whole video answers>>

claims.from: <<course if it comes from their materials, outside otherwise>>
claims.source: <<the source: book and edition, slide deck, or website name>>
claims.where: <<course: page, slide or section number; outside: the full https:// address>>
claims.checked: <<outside only: the date you read it, YYYY-MM-DD>>
claims.quote: <<the exact words from the source that say this fact, copied letter for letter>>

misconception.wrong: <<a common mistaken idea about this topic>>

beats.say: <<a hook sentence, a question or everyday observation>>
<<one sentence that names a new word and says what it means>>

pause.ask: <<a question the learner can answer from what was just said>>
pause.answer: <<the right option, exactly as written above>>

recall.ask: Look away from the screen. <<ask them to explain the main idea in two or three sentences>>

practice.ask: <<one new problem or case like the one taught>>
